values.note: Reservable online up to 365 days ahead and for the same day ('Reservations can be made for today'), or at 1-888-432-2267. Campsite check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.; campers arriving after 10 p.m. quiet hours are not admitted.

booking.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/janes-island-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380116 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/janesisland.aspx ('Check-in time for all campsites is 3pm and checkout time is 1 pm.'; 'Campers who arrive after 10:00 PM will not be allowed into the park'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/janesisland.aspx ('over 105 campsites, 50 of which are equipped with electrical hook-ups') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/janes-island-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380116 (per-site details: every RV-category electric site lists 'Electrical Service (amp): 30'; no water or sewer service listed), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DNR: 'over 105 campsites, 50 of which are equipped with electrical hook-ups'. The booking site lists 101 drive-in campsites in Loops A-C (45 electric, 56 non-electric) plus two tent-only electric sites in the Cabin Loop and three boat-in backcountry sites; listed max vehicle lengths run 20 to 50 ft, and eight sites are pull-through.

sites.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/janesisland.aspx + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/janes-island-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380116 (site list and per-site details: Looking For Category, Driveway Entry, Max Vehicle Length), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/janesisland.aspx ('Three centrally located bath houses have hot water showers and flush toilets.'; 'Camp Store') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/janes-island-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380116 (Services and Amenities: Camp Store, Dump Station, Showers), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on DNR's Janes Island page and the MD booking site: reservable 365 days ahead and same-day; 30-amp electric (no water/sewer listed); over 105 campsites (101 drive-in on the booking site) to 50 ft with some pull-throughs; bathhouses with showers and flush toilets, dump, camp store. Fees (human-checked 2026-10-12) match the booking table ($27.50 electric; non-electric row $14-30 spans backcountry). Season (manual) matches: sites 48-51 year-round, the rest Mar 27-Nov 28 2026. Weekend/holiday minimums: DNR states a 2-night minimum only for the lodge (campsites left inherited). Phone 410-968-1565 matches. Note kept.
flags: Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's park page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/janesisland.aspx.
